authDiagnosis.tokenHandling: Clerk SDK getToken() was used only in-memory in the browser and immediately attached to Bearer API calls. Token contents, cookies, and authorization headers were not logged or persisted.
authDiagnosis.result: Authenticated principal is available. Root remains public; explicit /plans/new rendered after load. /dashboard was tried explicitly and returned 404 (not the commercial route).
authDiagnosis.appInitiatedApiMeNote: The app UI made authenticated plan GET/PUT calls successfully (GET 200, PUT 200), but the app-initiated /api/me request headers were not separately captured; the in-browser manual Bearer /api/me check was captured and succeeded.

checks.evidence: Both fresh sessions had loaded Clerk user/session state; in-browser Bearer /api/me returned HTTP 200 and matching actual IDs. The earlier plain fetch 401 was due to missing SDK bearer token, not absent Clerk sessions.

Separate QA tenant add-on 3c0399ee-9fef-47d3-8d9e-ba303a549dc8 was configured at 20/200/0/0 and attached to the QA tenant. checks.name: Disposable tenant subscription, cancellation/suspension/restore, private note exclusion, admin summary
checks.evidence: QA tenant 5761557d-ec7e-4965-bf8f-cc87db05d9ec and its single customer membership were created in scope; QA add-on assignment returned HTTP 200. The corrected commercial save with Yearly/10%, a private operator note, and a non-empty reason returned HTTP 200; reload confirmed the same settings and USD 990.00/year estimate. Cancel showed `Subscription cancelled` and suspended/read-only access; Restore returned HTTP 200 to Draft with subscription active. Tenant remains unactivated. The customer subscription GET returned HTTP 403 and the private operator note did not appear in customer views.

checks.name: Customer order, customer-visible note, own-order notifications/read isolation, and role permissions
checks.evidence: Customer POST created WL-000129 (UUID 0d0714dc-ac1c-4dad-954e-2d134a6e102d) and it remains New/pending review with no payment, delivery, activation, or provisioning. The operator added one truthful customer-visible pending-review note (POST HTTP 201, UUID 6077dec2-cd16-4e32-aa54-1ce80c3f9f6e). The customer My Orders list contained only WL-000129; Dashboard showed only its two notifications. Marking the note notification read left the original submission notification unread, and this state persisted after reload. Customer subscription GET returned 403; direct navigation to the operator client route redirected to `/account`. No tenant private note appeared in customer views; My White Labels remains empty because no project was delivered.

checks.name: Responsive plan/add-on/account/tenant-tab overflow at 1440x900, 768x1024, 390x844
checks.evidence: Plans, Add-ons, Account, and the QA tenant Plans & Add-ons tab were checked at 1440x900, 768x1024, and 390x844; document-level horizontal overflow was absent on all sampled routes/sizes. Plans/Add-ons become stacked cards on mobile. The tenant tab row uses an inner horizontal scroller at 768/390; at 390 the selected Plans & Add-ons tab was initially partly clipped at scrollLeft=0 but became fully visible after scrolling it into view. At 768 the customer Dashboard's four metric-card labels wrap awkwardly inside words (e.g. REQUEST/S and AWAITIN/G REVIEW); content remains accessible and the page does not overflow horizontally.
